## Featured Projects

- [Zenius AI](https://github.com/Mediwateyash/Live-Meet): Real-time e-learning platform built at MSRDC featuring WebRTC live video classrooms, Gemini AI quiz generator, automated certificates, and role-based dashboards. Built with React, Tailwind CSS, Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB, Socket.IO, WebRTC, and Gemini API.
- [CaptionFlow](https://github.com/AniketK100/AI-Powered-Video-Captioning-Language-Conversion-Platform): Multilingual AI video captioning platform with styled subtitle export. Transcribes audio via Groq Whisper & Sarvam AI with provider fallback, word-level LCS timestamp synchronization, and FFmpeg rendering. Built with React, Node.js, Express.js, FFmpeg, Groq Whisper, and Sarvam AI.
- [LinkGuard](https://github.com/Sahil-Ghorpade/LinkGuard): URL shortener under 100ms with visitor analytics, QR code generation, JWT authentication, rate limiting, and Redis caching. Built with Java, Spring Boot, React, PostgreSQL, Redis, and Docker.
- [Loopora](https://github.com/AniketK100/Loopora): AI-powered interview preparation platform featuring 500+ questions, written answers, video explanations, and Gemini API personalization. Built with Next.js, TypeScript, MongoDB, Gemini API, and Tailwind CSS.
